welcomeSub: Small steps count. This app supports you on hard days.
supportiveStatement: Take your time today. You don't have to do everything.
safetyAnchorNotice: You are not alone. 24/7 confidential support.
emotionalCheckInSub: A quiet, non-judgmental space to name how you feel right now.
howAreYouFeeling: How are you feeling right now?
wordsResonate: What words resonate with this state?
chooseAsMany: Choose as many as you need
keyContext: Any key context shaping this moment?
privateNote: Anything you wish to jot down?
privateNotePlaceholder: Write here... this is only for you. No judgement, no metrics.
savedLocallyHaven: Stored locally on your device in your safe haven.
reassuranceToast: Thank you for checking in. Whatever you feel is welcome here. There is no right or wrong state of being.
checkInsThisWeekSub: You have been checking in with yourself with kindness. No streaks to hold, just space whenever you need it.
sanctuaryQuote: Take all the time you need. Every season of feeling has its own quiet purpose.
noMissedDayPenalties: No missed day penalties. Serenly meets you only when you arrive.
privateJournalSub: A private, quiet sanctuary for your unedited thoughts.
endToEndEncrypted: End-to-end encrypted & completely private. Only stored locally on your device.
writeHereOnlyForYou: Write here... this is only for you. No judgement, no expectations.
stuckOnWritingSub: Take 3 deep breaths before opening the next sentence. You do not have to solve anything right now.
zeroKnowledgeNotice: Serenly will never monetize, scan, or share your private journal entries. No advertisers, no trackers, no AI profiling. Your reflections belong solely to your healing journey.
copingSanctuarySub: Gentle sensory resets, breathwork, and ambient soundscapes.
groundingSub: Bring your awareness gently into the present physical space.
g1: 5 things you can see around you
g5: 1 thing you can taste or savor
goalsSub: Small achievable anchors. No guilt, no streak punishment.
medsSub: Consistent reminders for your personal wellness regimen.
medDisclaimer: Follow the instructions provided by your healthcare professional. Serenly does not provide medical guidance.
communitySub: A gentle space for mutual human warmth. No likes, followers, or competitive engagement.
communitySharePrompt: Share a kind thought or words of encouragement...
profSupportSub: Verified therapists and counselors ready to assist.
profDisclaimer: Serenly facilitates connections with licensed professionals. If in crisis, use emergency options.
emergencyMsg: If you or someone you know feels overwhelmed or unsafe, immediate help is available right now.
call988: Call or Text 988 (USA Suicide & Crisis Lifeline)
